subject: Decision: parent CSP stays script-src 'self'. The official iframe_api runs inside an opaque-origin sandboxed frame (S06 Mermaid pattern); seg20 implements, seg22 verifies
body: Reason: a third-party script in our origin can read the Supabase session — not acceptable. Don't hand-roll the undocumented widget postMessage protocol (fragile, and CLAUDE.md says use the official IFrame player). Pattern: a static same-origin page (e.g. /embed/youtube.html) served with its OWN CSP (script-src https://www.youtube.com; frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com) and loaded in an iframe with sandbox="allow-scripts allow-presentation" (no allow-same-origin → opaque origin, cannot read our storage). Inside it, iframe_api drives the nocookie player; it talks to the parent only through a small typed postMessage bridge (play/pause/seek/rate in; ready/state/time/error out), validated by source + shape. Keep the click-to-load facade; nothing loads before the click. Revert script-src in the production CSP to 'self'; add a test asserting the parent CSP has no third-party script-src, and an e2e that plays/seeks via the bridge.
